_: A deliberately coarse model of a Milestone-1 playthrough, so the stat maths can be stress-tested against something shaped like the real game rather than against isolated duels. Content shape comes from docs/quests/00-overview.md (24 main quests, 4 deep lines of 10-12, 4 standard lines of 6-8, 60-80 regional/standalone, 15-25 micro chains; ~170-210 journaled quests; 130-180 h at maturity) and the danger geography of world 20 §12. Every number here is a guess with a reason, not a measurement — treat the output as a smell test, never as a target.

playerSkill._: How much of an enemy's output an ordinary player avoids, as they learn the game. Souls players get better; the sim should not assume they arrive perfect or stay clumsy.

styleAvoidanceBonus._: Not every build stands still and trades. A bow build opens at range and backs off; a stealth build picks its moment and disengages; a mage keeps distance while the magicka lasts. This is the crude stand-in for that, and it is why the harness does not conclude that light armour is unplayable.

sneakOpenerChance._: How often a build gets the first blow unseen.

deathModel._: A lost fight is a death: you wake at your last rest, your vastei pile is on the floor where you fell, and you walk back. Players do not lose the same fight forever - they come back better prepared - so a loss costs time and the pile, then resolves.

acts.label: Act I — Lilmoth, the dead clutch, the first roads
Act II — faction work, the interior opens
Act III — deep marsh, xanmeers, the cult's ground
Endgame — the hardest ground, artifacts, the Throne
Post-game — mop-up, optional D5, mastery projects

spending._: Where a player's gold goes. Training is the sink that matters for progression; the rest is upkeep.

nonCombatUse._: Use-points per quest for the skills that are not swung at anything. Athletics is per kilometre travelled, acrobatics per ten metres climbed, and the social/utility skills per check attempted.

overreach._: Players wander. A fixed world means a share of encounters are simply above the band you are ready for - that is the whole point of it (0004). This is how often that happens.
